thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Canary error rate spike detected for 'model-v2.3' in eu-west-1. 5xx > 5% for 3m, latency p95 up 2x. Pager: devon (oncall).

devon (oncall): pulling smoke dashboard now, will triage. tagging @matt_r for deploy context.

matt_r: saw the canary rollout started at 21:05 UTC, only 8% traffic shift. suspect request batching optimization in runtime.

sara_ops: routed a few customer complaints to support, low volume but can confirm 502s. setting priority P1.

devon (oncall): ok. initiating safety-ladder: 1) pause traffic shift 2) flip canary flag to baseline 3) drain canary pods 4) smoke verify. who's available to flip flag?

matt_r: I can flip now. command: `redwood feature-flag toggle --name canary_v2_3 --state off --env eu-west-1`

matt_r: executed flag toggle at 21:18 UTC. response: `200 OK`

devon (oncall): confirming control plane shows flag=false, traffic shift stopped. starting graceful drain on canary pool (drain timeout 60s).

sara_ops: customer-facing note queued: "We observed degraded responses for a small subset of requests in eu-west-1; we've reverted a recent canary and are monitoring. No broader impact expected."

jordan_pm: thanks — please ping me if rollback exposes any data integrity or contract regressions.

matt_r: drain progress: 3/12 canary instances still active, kube evict in flight. logs show reduced 502s already.

devon (oncall): running quick probe set now (10 requests across endpoints + auth flow).

matt_r: probe results: 10/10 success, p95 latency back to baseline. errors down to ~0.4%.

sara_ops: monitoring external errors and SLO dashboard, no further customer escalations for last 6m.

devon (oncall): will keep the rollback in place and mark rollout aborted. next steps: create a postmortem ticket, capture repro and kernel/batching change, and plan a canary with smaller batch + extended smoke window.

incident-bot: Note: incident created INC-2026-0425-312, severity=P1, owner=devon (oncall). Add timeline and links: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-0425-312

jordan_pm: can you add an ETA for follow-up investigation?

devon (oncall): initial triage estimate 4 hrs. I'll hand off to matt for deeper kernel/batching traces. marking oncall handoff to matt at 22:00 UTC for postmortem follow-up.

matt_r: acknowledged, will collect logs and KV cache metrics. updating incident ticket with steps to reproduce.

sara_ops: closing public customer note in 30m unless we see regressions.

devon (oncall): final status for now: rollback complete, traffic restored to baseline, customer impact contained. will post summary in #postmortems when done. :white_check_mark:
